title: Startup blocks for minutes reading every delegation row (SELECT id, value_json FROM delegations ORDER BY rowid) from a ~700 MB store before the host is usable
outcome: The HTTP listener binds before delegation payload loading. A single owned background operation restores the full inventory off StateInner and the async reactor, then atomically publishes complete records and indexes. Inventory-dependent operations fail closed while loading or failed; unrelated routes remain usable, history and recovery semantics are preserved, and no schema floor is added.
acceptance: The HTTP listener binds before any delegation value_json payload is read or decoded. Existing session/metadata loading may remain synchronous. The host immediately serves routes that do not require the delegation inventory; inventory-dependent requests receive a typed starting-up or unavailable response until the inventory is complete. Increasing completed delegation history does not increase pre-bind delegation payload rows or bytes.

After the listener binds, one owned background operation reads and decodes the full delegation inventory without holding StateInner or blocking an async reactor. A complete inventory is installed at one publication boundary with an explicit completeness witness; failures retain an unavailable witness and never publish a partial inventory as complete. Shutdown and stale-source or conflicting-writer outcomes do not silently install or discard durable history.

Completeness-dependent delegation admissions, child/root classification, catalog joins, recovery, waits and destructive cleanup fail closed or wait with a bound until the complete inventory is installed. Existing delegation records, result/output history, ownership, durability fences, acknowledgement ordering and malformed/mismatched-record quarantine remain preserved. Unloaded or unavailable data is never treated as absent or as completed recovery, and unrelated writes cannot delete or replace unloaded delegation rows with defaults.

Deterministic regressions compare small/large completed histories and a large payload, verify zero pre-bind delegation payload work, prove SQL/decode run off StateInner, and cover pending-to-complete and failure behavior, required recovery, child exclusion, historical reads and write/restart preservation. Logs report listener-bind and inventory-complete elapsed times.

Fresh focused compilation and tests covering the final change and affected guards, plus independent Codex/Claude read-only reviews with complete exported packets/prose, pass on the exact frozen candidate. All Medium-or-higher findings are fixed and reviewed again; any unfixed Low is tracked separately. Merger owns the exact-input maintained full gate and landing.
